description: This file provides utility functions for random number generation, string creation, and seeding, with thread safety and custom character set to avoid vowels and bad words.

methods.name: Intn
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random integer in the range [0, max).

methods.name: IntnRange
methods.description: Generates an integer in the range [min, max).

methods.name: Int63nRange
methods.description: Generates an int64 in the range [min, max).

methods.name: Seed
methods.description: Seeds the random number generator with a provided seed.

methods.name: Perm
methods.description: Returns a slice of n ints representing a random permutation of [0, n).

methods.name: String
methods.description: Generates a random alphanumeric string of length n, excluding vowels.

methods.name: SafeEncodeString
methods.description: Encodes a string using the same character set as String to reduce bad words and ensure consistency.
